name: shopping-assistant-gateway-sync-15min
description: Every 15 minutes: copy the AI Gateway's policy decisions, and the final user message and reply as the gateway sent them after its policies, into shopping_assistant.raw_logs (guardrail_results_raw, node_executions_raw). Insert only; calls already synced are skipped and calls whose gateway trace has not landed yet are retried next run. Starts as a DRY RUN (write=false) and PAUSED.
